✦ Research Projects

  • Eclipsing Binary True Obliquities

    Joint Photometric Transit and RV fits of the Rossiter-McLaughlin Effect to calculate true obliquities of short period eclipsing stellar binaries.

  • Stellar Flare-Spot Correlation

    Absence of correlated stellar spot and flare occurrence using new flare detection algorithm TOFFEE on TESS photometry.

  • Sympathetic Flares

    Detection of sympathy in stellar flare occurrence rates at short wait times using new flare detection algorithm TOFFEE on TESS photometry.
